independent_solve.reasoning:
In a series LCR circuit, the supply voltage $V$ is given by the phasor sum of the voltages across the resistor ($V_R$), inductor ($V_L$), and capacitor ($V_C$):
$V = \sqrt{V_R^2 + (V_L - V_C)^2}$

Given:
$V_L = 60\text{ V}$
$V_C = 30\text{ V}$
$V_R = 40\text{ V}$

Substitute the values into the formula:
$V = \sqrt{40^2 + (60 - 30)^2} = \sqrt{40^2 + 30^2} = \sqrt{1600 + 900} = \sqrt{2500} = 50\text{ V}$

Thus, the supply voltage is 50 V.
